decisions.reason: The IMU sensor module is a core building block in the modular system, and it gained its own page in 2024, which signals ongoing support.
The industrial AC input module is newly promoted, has its own page and fits the firm's industrial automation direction.
Relay modules are a staple of the platform and cost little to keep in stock, though it is only mentioned on the website.
The LED control module is a recent addition to the building block range, and keeping it in the catalog costs little.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion of charging and energy management.
